_comment: The client time systems Icon actually bills through, and so the systems the test set must cover (docs/roadmap.md PR 12). Kevin has not answered which they are yet - the question is open in docs/open-questions.md - so the list is empty and every case in the set is made-up. Add a system here as soon as it is known: the test set then has to carry at least one anonymised real timesheet from it, or CI fails. A case says which system it came from in its own meta.json.
